sources.title: Guide: Pools
sources.locator: lines 1-180 (making a pool, roles, who may message whom, team tools)
sources.finding: A pool is a team of sessions with a lead, members and a reviewer that share messages, notes and tasks through AI Juggler's connector; message rules include members ask you first; the person makes pools and approves what matters.

sources.title: Guide: Pools, Tasks section
sources.locator: Tasks and What you can do on a task
sources.finding: Agents write and run tasks with ids like aj-7f3c, statuses Ready, In progress, In review, Blocked, To do, Done; epics and stories; waits-on links block until done; only one session can take a task; person can approve, send back, free, cancel or start a session for a task; no New task button.

sources.title: juggler-core tasks.rs
sources.finding: Task kinds epic, story and task with parent, short id, title, body, acceptance criteria, priority, status, assignee and optional external issue link; links blocks, relates to, duplicates; readiness computed from open blockers.

sources.title: Guide: Usage and limits

sources.title: Guide: Sessions and the terminal

sources.finding: Session list groups open sessions by app; History holds every ended session, searchable by words; index for outside sessions is opt-in.

sources.title: Guide: Fleet
sources.finding: Other Macs in one window: their sessions and usage, starting a session on one, carrying a conversation; paired Macs talk directly over the local network with no relay.

sources.title: Guide: Keep work going
sources.finding: Off by default; a crashed session is started again and each restart is noted; the Mac can be kept awake while sessions work.

sources.title: Guide: Continue in another app
sources.finding: Switching moves a conversation's files between accounts of one tool and resumes, or tells the other tool the story so far between Claude Code and Codex; not lossless and shown before confirming.

sources.title: Guide: What AI Juggler touches
sources.finding: Caches stay local; agents write tasks and the app writes none; the Figurehead account is optional; Fleet connects only paired Macs directly and encrypted.

sources.title: Usage statistics
sources.finding: Usage statistics are Off by default, Keep on this computer, or Share weekly; chosen in onboarding with nothing preselected; switching Off deletes local data.

sources.title: AI Juggler recovery-tasks
sources.locator: may_plan/may_change 540-610; storage/tasks.rs migration and update; agentbridge/task_tools.rs task_update; app/features/tasks/issues.rs; ui/src/pages/tasks/PoolTasks.tsx and TaskView.tsx
sources.finding: Leads plan all kinds and edit any task; others plan tasks and edit their own unheld or held tasks. Kind is immutable in update; no archive operation. Tasks and append-only events persist in SQLite; event triggers reject changes/deletes. GitHub issue/PR title and state are looked up through gh with a 10-second timeout; Linear is a labelled link. No external writes/sync. Review queue, plan grouping, reviewer verdicts and send-back notes exist, with responsive stacked detail below the lg breakpoint; no exact-revision merge gate.

sources.title: AI Juggler recovery-notes
sources.locator: insert_doc/docs/doc 1236-1310, event migration; agentbridge/mcp.rs tools; guide/pools.md shared notes and approvals
sources.finding: Shared docs have immutable ids, sha256, author, pool and creation time; sharing inserts another record, not an in-place note edit. No note-delete or freshness-expiry operation in the bridge/storage inventory. Notes and events persist locally. Pool permissions offer Allow once/Always allow and Take back from the next request. Pause/Stop controls messaging, not OS process suspension.

sources.title: AI Juggler recovery-runtime
sources.locator: module contract and quit flow; guide/keep-work-going.md; guide/sessions-and-the-terminal.md; supervisor/supervisor.rs process lifecycle
sources.finding: Closing the window hides it and keeps sessions running. Quitting ends app-owned terminal sessions; external desktop and re-adopted sessions can continue. Crash restart is opt-in, maximum three in ten minutes, resumes only when conversation identity is known, otherwise fresh. No generic exactly-once replay ledger for arbitrary commands; task claims and Fleet requests have narrower deduplication. No task run budget or compute scheduler in supervisor/bridge/task inventory; messaging hop limits and remote-operation deadlines are distinct.

sources.title: AI Juggler recovery-ai
sources.locator: whole guide; app/features/ai model selection/download implementation
sources.finding: Public opt-in beta local AI jobs write turn reviews and answer Chat questions using Apple on-device models or an explicitly downloaded Qwen3 1.7B model. These are helper models, not extra coding harnesses.

sources.title: AI Juggler recovery-data
sources.locator: How a report works; guide/trust.md reads/writes/sends; guide/switching.md Save a handover and import
sources.finding: Optional anonymous weekly raw telemetry reports persist for 35 days then aggregates; sent reports cannot be located for individual deletion. Off deletes local stats. Fleet can move conversations explicitly. Pasted service keys use macOS Keychain; Kimi local server token is a stated exception. Handover files can be saved/imported. Account/backup provider policy remains separate.

sources.title: AI Juggler recovery-scope
sources.locator: whole guide; guide/pools.md 330-440; app features inventory searched for SSO, RBAC, schedule, webhook, git push, pr create, worktree add, container; ui/src/pages/tasks/TaskView.tsx
sources.finding: Fleet connects paired Macs directly, including via Tailscale/WireGuard. View versus control, optional ask-each-time and pair revocation are available. These do not establish named-person shared workspaces or organisation roles. Pool task review is available; no product-owned git shipping, security sandbox, code-index service, spec-drift engine or external work scheduler in the inspected modules.

sources.title: AI Juggler usage-stats and crash-report consent gates at commit 030f839
sources.locator: crates/juggler-app/src/usage_stats.rs lines 1-6 and 78-94 (stored choice off when unset; recorder starts only unless off); crates/juggler-app/src/crash.rs lines 125-152 (setting never when unset; DO_NOT_TRACK forces never); crates/juggler-app/src/crash_send.rs line 43; crates/juggler-app/src/updates.rs lines 1-8 and 59-62 (update feed on GitHub releases)
sources.finding: The usage-statistics choice is off when unset, and only Share mode sends weekly reports; switching off deletes local stats. The crash-report setting is never when unset, and DO_NOT_TRACK forces never. Update checks read GitHub releases, and the daily signed configuration download carries no user data.
